title: Critique: folk psychology is not committed to sentences in the head, or to the neural level

statements.text: It is a mistake to treat folk psychology as committed to a quasi-linguistic structure for attitudes, and many cognitive scientists accept representations without it. And as a computer's circuitry is the wrong level for its symbol structures, the brain's detailed wiring may be the wrong level to look for beliefs.

sources.locator: section 3.2.1, 'Challenging The Syntactic Structure Of Beliefs'
sources.quote: many have argued that it is a mistake to treat folk psychology as committed to a quasi-linguistic structure to propositional attitudes
